title: Every SaaS starts with the same nine weeks.
lede: AI doesn't remove this work — it improvises it. Same invented auth, same tenant leaks, same billing edge cases, only shipped in an afternoon instead of two months.
ledeStrong: Faster isn't the same as solved.
compareBefore: Hiring a backend engineer for 3 months:
ledgerHeading: Backend — before you write a line of product
mobileLedgerHeading: Mobile — before you write a line of product
byHandText: Two months of code the world already wrote, re-shipping the same security flaws.
withAiText: Same improvised infrastructure, same flaws. The timeline collapses; the problem doesn't.
mobileCompare: Hiring a backend engineer: $30–60k. Rebuilding the same mobile screens for your 3rd client: priceless frustration. Starting with Fonderie: free and open source.
customApiLine: Custom product = custom API = no support when you scale.
tokenBurnLine: And when your AI improvises a login flow, you burn 3,000 tokens debugging it. Every. Session.
opportunityCostLine: That's 9 weeks you're not talking to customers. 9 weeks you're not shipping features. 9 weeks of runway burned on code the world already wrote.
